outcome: Maternal adjustment (Maternal Adjustment and Attitudes scale)
Postnatal depressive symptoms (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: 371 nulliparous women with severe fear of childbirth (Wijma Delivery Expectancy Questionnaire score ≥100) out of 4575 screened.
finding: In nulliparous women with severe fear of childbirth, participation in a targeted psychoeducative group resulted in better maternal adjustment, a less fearful childbirth experience, and fewer postnatal depressive symptoms compared with conventional care.
